title: Dataq Swarm — Overview
meta_description: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.

blocks.x: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce. Dataq Swarm is the platform layer behind it — deployed under NDA, documented for the audit.

Dataq Swarm is the orchestration layer for agentic operations: role definitions, task queues and bidding, durable execution with saga compensation, policy envelopes (solo/approval/forbidden), per-team budgets, kill switches, and a control tower for fleet health, throughput and cost per completed task. Swarm treats agents as workforce, not scripts: onboarding with role specs, SLAs and budget; release management with shadow and canary cohorts; incident response with rollback. It runs our agentic process automation, digital workforce and workflow orchestration services under one accountable control plane.
What ships, in the order it ships — Dataq Swarm edition:

items: health, throughput, cost and policy telemetry
roles, bidding, priority lanes, SLA routing

blocks.title: Dataq Swarm — module topology
blocks.note: Modules are the platform's named components; trust lane is what the audit reads.

blocks.x: Every agent action is policy-checked and logged under immutable audit trails. Tool access is scoped per role with short-lived credentials; high-risk actions require approval workflows. Swarm's evidence pack maps to ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF expectations for agentic systems.
Where you would find it working

Dataq Swarm runs under NDA in Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Logistics & Supply Chain, Public Sector & Government. Deployments stay private; the architecture and control packs are the part we can show.
Connects to: Temporal, LangGraph, Kafka, OPA, Kubernetes, core/SaaS connectors. Adapters are versioned and contract-tested, so upgrades stop being incidents.
Bring Dataq Swarm to a 45-minute briefing with the practice lead — your metric, our method, and an honest read on feasibility.
